shared_elements: elongated linear objects (staff/spear-like or arc forms)
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic outlined motifs including a round disc-like element and elongated linear forms, but that is where the correspondence ends. A shows only non-figural abstract signs (a raised disc above arcs and a lattice-like block), while B shows an unmistakable human figure in profile-action raising a long spear or oar with small boats, cup-marks and animal-like signs around it; no shared relationship or arrangement exists.
